delegation.question: S20
delegation.scope: Choose measurement approach; not permission to purchase, deploy, or start a phase.

interpretations.S10: Preview-count inclusion is deferred/excluded from production totals; does not independently cancel other authorized preview workflows.
interpretations.S14: No additional incomplete-day badge is required; never fabricate missing measurements.
interpretations.S15: Footer contact/social/QR content, not additional click/conversion counters. QR material will be supplied later by the owner.
interpretations.S17: IP-based abuse prevention/rate limiting required; raw-IP history/publication is not requested.
interpretations.S19: Keep anonymous aggregate pageviews for visitors declining identification; do not infer a unique visitor identity for them.
